description:
Introducing EQUILIBRIUM Elysion - a carbon/titanium hybrid fully integrated system designed for going fast!

This bike offers the perfect blend of performance and comfort, with a balanced stiffness to compliance ratio that allows for long periods of fast riding without fatigue.

The use of 3D printing technologies and modern materials such as titanium and carbon have resulted in a bike that dampens road chatter and provides increased control for optimal handling.

Experience the performance of carbon, the smoothness of titanium, and the comfort of steel with the EQUILIBRIUM Elysion.

Every Elysion frame set comes with ENVE in route fork and integrated cockpit.

Fully integrated cable routing system allows for the clean aesthetics and aero performance gains.

Titanium 3D printed lugs perfectly blend with carbon D-shaped custom made head tube

The 3D printed drop outs that seamlessly flow into straight taper massive chain stays are one of the most exclusive features that make Elysion stand out of the crowd, and it also has a dedicated routing for the Di2 rear derailleur cable.

Upgrade your ride with a super stiff and durable 3D printed T47 bottom bracket and carbon seat tube. The unique design ensures a hyper-responsive ride feel for serious cyclists.

The slender seat stays on Elysion are designed to enhance your comfort during your ride. By increasing the vertical compliance, they add suspension to the rear triangle, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable experience.

Elysion offers the ultimate cycling experience with premium Columbus Hyperion titanium tubing from Italy. The D-shaped down tube is integrated into the frame's design for improved riding quality and stability. Choose Elysion for unparalleled performance.
